name: Finance Tracker
tagline: Track income, expenses, and monthly category budgets
description: A local financial ledger tool. Actions: add_transaction (needs type, amount, category, description, date), get_summary (needs start_date, end_date, category), list_transactions (needs limit, type, category), delete_transaction (needs id), create_category (needs category, description, limit), list_categories, update_category (needs category, new_name, description, limit), delete_category (needs category, merge_to).

type.description: Required for add_transaction. Type of the transaction.

amount.description: Required for add_transaction. The numeric value of the transaction.

category.description: The target budget/expense category (e.g., Food, Entertainment, Salary). Required for add_transaction, set_budget, create_category, update_category, delete_category.

new_name.description: Optional for update_category. The new name for the category.

merge_to.description: Optional for delete_category. The category name to merge existing transactions into (defaults to General).

description.description: Optional for add_transaction, create_category, update_category. Description of the transaction or category.

date.description: Optional for add_transaction. Date format YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to current date if omitted.

start_date.description: Optional for get_summary. Filter summary starting from YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Optional for get_summary. Filter summary ending on YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Optional for create_category, update_category, set_budget. Monthly budget limit for the category.

id.description: Required for delete_transaction. The unique transaction ID.
